title: Building a governed trading system slowly and methodically
author: TrustedEssentials
selftext:
I’ve been building a broker-neutral trading research system called Forge. The goal isn’t to let AI make trading decisions, it’s to create a deterministic process where every strategy change, test, result, and promotion decision is recorded and verifiable.

Right now i'm still in the research stage. I have historical replay, backtesting, walk-forward testing, risk metrics, experiment governance, and resumable studies working. I'm currently testing one regime-filtered momentum strategy with several risk configurations to see whether the system can choose a safer setup without destroying the edge. No paper or live trading yet.

I’m deliberately taking this slowly because I’d rather uncover weaknesses now than after money is involved of course.

For those of you who have built trading systems, what problems or surprises did you run into along the way? What ended up being harder than you expected?
